note: Your class gives you a resource system and passives, but any class can equip any weapon — the weapon is what actually decides your range, mobility and skill access. This is a starting reference, not an exhaustive list; Farever is in Early Access and keeps adding weapon types.

weapons.name: Sword
weapons.tell: The most balanced melee weapon — reliable single-target damage with no real weaknesses. Great sword and dual-wielded variants push it further into pure damage territory.

weapons.name: Axe
weapons.tell: Heavier hits with cleave against grouped enemies. The dual-axe and great-axe variants trade defense for even more damage.

weapons.name: Mace
weapons.tell: A support-friendly melee option — enough damage to hold your own while still being able to carry healing/buff kit alongside it.

weapons.name: Spear
weapons.tell: The one weapon every class can make good use of, thanks to its reach — poke and interrupt from just outside melee range.

weapons.name: Shield
weapons.tell: An off-hand block/parry tool. Mostly a Warrior staple, but a Mage carrying one gives up some magic damage for real survivability.

weapons.name: Daggers
weapons.tell: The fastest attack speed in the game — builds combo resources quickly for a big finishing hit, at the cost of almost no defense.

weapons.name: Bow
weapons.tell: Ranged damage with strong mobility uptime — shoot while repositioning instead of committing to melee range.

weapons.name: Fists
weapons.tell: Fast, low-commitment strikes for steady combo generation — more consistent than daggers, less peak burst.

weapons.name: Thrown
weapons.tell: A utility option for punishing targets at range or softening something before it closes the distance.

weapons.name: Staff
weapons.tell: The Mage's core damage weapon — the highest per-cast damage and longest range of any weapon, paired with the lowest survivability.

weapons.name: Book
weapons.tell: Leans toward area-of-effect and control on a Mage, or a heal/damage hybrid on a Priest — a flexible middle-ground caster weapon.

weapons.name: Halos
weapons.tell: A more balanced magic weapon blending damage with utility — a common pick for solo casters who can't rely on a healer nearby.

weapons.name: Scepter
weapons.tell: The Priest's exclusive weapon, built entirely around efficient group healing and buffs.

weapons.name: Crescent
weapons.tell: A support-leaning utility weapon; details are still thin this early into Early Access — treat it as a situational pick until more is confirmed.

weapons.name: Capture Net
weapons.tell: A utility weapon tied to Farever's taming/pet systems rather than raw combat output.
